R781.note: htmlspecialchars(ENT_QUOTES,'UTF-8') on the echoed note correctly closes the XSS with no other behavior change.

R782.note: Standard Laravel can:refund,order policy middleware gated before the controller runs; ownership check via user_id matches typical Order shape and preserves response shape.

R783.note: Regex rejects CRLF/control chars before the raw SMTP write; minor: regex is stricter than RFC5321 (may reject some valid unusual addresses) but not disclosed as a tradeoff, so only a small ding.

R785.note: Traversal/type-confusion vector properly closed (random UUID name, MIME-derived extension, moved out of PUBLIC_DIR), but the new download route sets Content-Disposition: attachment, which makes browsers force-download the file instead of rendering it inline in an tag - breaking the core avatar-display use case. This is stated in the code/text but not flagged as a functional regression.

R786.note: Adds Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite; matches contract, additions are disclosed and don't block legitimate use.

R787.note: Removing the ignoringRequestMatchers exemption restores default CSRF protection exactly as the contract requires; no other change.

R788.note: Allowlist map for filters.table (identity map) blocks injection while keeping default ledger_entries and bound accountId/status; matches contract.

R789.note: Narrows the CSRF exemption to /api/webhooks/** exactly per the code's own stated intent.

R790.note: subprocess.run with argument array and shell=False correctly closes the shell-injection sink; the explanation's claim that the regex '[a-zA-Z0-9._:-]+' rejects leading '-' is inaccurate (the char class includes '-' anywhere), so residual argument-injection risk into ping is understated, but the reported CWE-78 vector is closed.

R791.note: Interim validation (reject CRLF, allowlist chars) correctly closes the raw-socket injection; the allowlist '^[a-zA-Z0-9_.\-/]+$' silently excludes folder names with spaces (e.g. common IMAP folders like 'Sent Items'), not disclosed as a limitation. The 'primary' Jakarta Mail fix also changes the method signature (Socket -> Session), an unstated compatibility break if the two options are conflated.

R792.note: escapeshellarg() correctly neutralizes shell metacharacters for the shell_exec sink; preserves behavior for legitimate hosts.

R793.note: Correct PreparedStatement/setString conversion, same as sibling Case03.

R794.note: unserialize(..., ['allowed_classes'=>false]) is the standard format-preserving fix for this exact scenario; arrays/scalars deserialize unchanged so the cart shape and empty-cart fallback are preserved.

R795.note: ldap.escapeFilterAttribute() is not an exported function of ldapjs (no such API exists in the library); calling it throws a TypeError at runtime, so every request to this endpoint would crash instead of being fixed - the vector is not closed and the endpoint silently stops working.

R796.note: Adds the missing $_FILES['avatar']['error'] check before finfo/move, matches the finding exactly.

R797.note: new ldap.EqualityFilter({attribute,value}) is a real, documented ldapjs pattern that auto-escapes the value on serialization - correctly closes the filter-injection vector.

R798.note: store.New() in gorilla/sessions still decodes an existing request cookie and sets IsNew=false exactly like store.Get() when a cookie is present - it does not discard an attacker-planted session cookie, so this is a no-op against session fixation despite the confident explanation. No other side effects introduced.

R799.note: Canonical erase-returns-next-iterator pattern; visits every element exactly once and preserves order.

R800.note: Allowlist dict maps request plugin name to real module path; unknown names rejected with 400.

R801.note: Replacing the raw inline-protocol socket with StackExchange.Redis's StringSet uses RESP length-prefixed encoding, closing CRLF injection while preserving the endpoint's success response.

R802.note: HTML::Entities::encode_entities on $subject correctly closes the XSS sink.

R803.note: Path.toRealPath() requires the target to already exist; called on the not-yet-created output file for every new entry, this throws NoSuchFileException before Files.copy ever runs, breaking extraction for every legitimate new file (contradicts 'valid nested archive entries still extract'). It also calls Files.createDirectories(target.getParent()) before the containment check, so directories can be created outside the destination for a traversal payload before the check rejects it.

R804.note: execFile() cannot launch a .bat file directly on Windows without shell:true (Node requires cmd.exe to interpret batch scripts); the write-up explicitly but incorrectly claims 'execFile() still successfully executes .bat files directly' - as written, every request would fail (EINVAL/ENOENT), breaking the endpoint rather than fixing it.

R805.note: Rejecting any URI with a non-null host or scheme (covers absolute and protocol-relative //host forms) correctly restricts redirects to relative paths while preserving existing syntax validation/error handling.

R806.note: Rejects path separators/dot-segments, canonicalizes with realpath, and verifies containment with a separator-anchored prefix check; also fixes the header-injection-adjacent filename echo via basename(canonicalPath).

R807.note: resize(count) fixes the reported out-of-bounds write into packet, but the contract explicitly requires rejecting/reporting counts larger than fields.size(), and this fix adds no such check - fields[i] still reads out of bounds when count > fields.size().

R808.note: SecureRandom + Base64Url token generation is a correct, standard replacement; token is only ever compared to itself so the format change is harmless.

R809.note: Hand-rolled escape covers all RFC 4515-mandated characters (*, (, ), \, NUL); extra escaping of '/' is unnecessary but harmless since \2f still decodes correctly.

R810.note: Rejects CRLF/NUL before building the RETR command, appropriate for this raw-socket sink.

R811.note: Saves offset before realloc and recomputes the pointer after, the standard fix for this stale-pointer-after-realloc pattern.

R812.note: secrets.choice() replacement is correct and preserves the 32-char alphanumeric token shape and JSON contract.

R813.note: mathjs's evaluate() removes eval()'s arbitrary code execution; the pinned ^12.0.0 range predates the known mathjs sandbox-escape CVEs (which affect 13.1.x-15.1.x), so the named version is not itself vulnerable.

R814.note: Reuses the existing escapeAuthorName() HTML-escaper on rawComment, closing the same gap already fixed for authorName.

R815.note: SimpleEvaluationContext.forReadOnlyDataBinding() removes method invocation/type refs/construction while still permitting SpEL's built-in arithmetic operators over the root object, matching the contract exactly.

R816.note: Allowlist dispatch map replacing $$cmd() closes arbitrary function invocation while preserving the two legitimate commands.

R817.note: Rejects spaces/CRLF in cacheKey before building the memcached inline command; appropriate validation for this sink.

R818.note: session_regenerate_id(true) is the correct, real PHP API and is placed before the session data is set, closing the fixation window.

R819.note: ProcessBuilder with a real argument array closes shell injection, and the explicit host.startsWith("-") check (in addition to the char-class regex) also closes the argument-injection gap that similar entries in this batch miss.

R820.note: The scheme check is gated on urlInput.includes('://'), but javascript: and data: URIs (the exact payload the write-up's own Source section cites, e.g. javascript:alert('XSS')) contain no '//' and so never enter the validation branch at all - the reported XSS vector is not closed. http/https/mailto legitimate links are unaffected.
